address: Centrale Groothandelsmarkt 183, Amsterdam-West (Food Center): 1935 wholesale food warehouse (De Kweker) with a 106 m west front of concrete-block piers under grey cladding, a loading canopy, an office ribbon and a raised centre block carrying the DE KWEKER sign
notes: Centrale Groothandelsmarkt 183 (BAG pand 0363100012202276, built 1935, 37 3DBAG wall surfaces, roof max 13.0 m): the De Kweker food wholesale warehouse in the Food Center Amsterdam, a long low hall with a curved roof. Photographed: the 106 m west front (w01-258, 2022-04-29), the north receiving end (w02-347, 2018-06-13) and the south end under a 50-year banner (w03-168, 2018-06-13).

walls[0] = panel 0 (W, 105 m, eaves 9.0, top 11.8; surfaces 1, 15, 16): grey cladding over concrete-block piers with the raised centre block carrying the DE KWEKER sign board; drawn as a blank render wall with the letters on a cornice band (the office ribbon covers only the middle 25 m, which one group per panel cannot isolate, so no windows are cut). walls[1] = panels 3 and 22 (N, 29 m and 9 m): the receiving end, drawn as a two-storey wall with a blank upper storey, a receiving door in bay 1 and ONTVANGST GOEDEREN on a fascia. Simplified: the cantilevered loading canopy, the red roller-shutter doors, the office ribbon and the white cold-store annex are not modelled; the sign board is letters, not a printed banner; the curved roof is the 3DBAG roof. Not drawn: the east wall and the south end (blank, banner only).
